rationale: The plan correctly recognizes the perfect confound, refuses a batch term and any ComBat-seq/removeBatchEffect/SVA correction, fits ~condition only under a stated no-batch-effect assumption, and labels every DE and enrichment output as confounded, matching the reference. Design formula, releveled reference, named contrast, median-of-ratios normalization inside the model, a justified minimal filter (>=10 in >=6 samples), BH at alpha 0.05 with apeglm shrinkage, and p-value histogram inspection are all explicit. QC covers blind VST, PCA and distances colored by condition and batch plus library sizes, but states no policy for handling a shallow library or PCA outlier beyond Cook's flagging in the model. GSEA uses the full Wald-ranked list, a named collection with version, explicit universe and 15-500 size window, and the report enumerates methods, versions, thresholds, gene counts and the central confounding caveat.
